_comment: PM-ENFORCE-1: what a role may not do by hand. The daemon hands a session of a listed role this entry as INFANTRY_ROLE_POLICY and the harness refuses the call. Each role has a boolean setting (default on) that turns its entry off, per app or per project.

pm.message: A PM delegates: it does not edit files, run git history commands or run builds and tests itself. Spawn a worker with the agents_spawn tool instead: fullstack, backend or frontend for code and tests, version-control (git) for merges, rebases and conflicts. Reading files and diffs, the board, mail and status checks stay allowed. The owner can turn this off with the setting policy.pm.handsOff.
